paper_title: Search for Axionlike Dark Matter Using Liquid-State Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
notes: This is a commissioning/proof-of-principle measurement of the CASPEr-Gradient Low-Field apparatus searching for ALP-proton gradient coupling. The paper reports a narrow-bandwidth search over 240 Hz centered at 1.348570 MHz, corresponding to ALP masses 5.576741–5.577733 neV/c². No signal was detected; the resulting upper limit is |g_ap| ≤ 3×10^−2 GeV^−1 at 95% confidence level. The measurement used thermally-polarized liquid methanol with 7.2×10^22 protons. The paper explicitly states the local DM density assumption ρ_DM ≈ 0.3 GeV/cm³ following the standard halo model. The coupling constant is reported in GeV^−1 as stated in the abstract and main text. The data point is encoded as a horizontal line spanning the narrow mass range searched, following the convention for mass-dependent bounds. Future measurements with hyperpolarized samples are projected to reach sensitivities of 10^−6 GeV^−1 or better over a much wider mass range (4.1 peV to 17 neV), but those are projections, not measured limits. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.92, 2))
